verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a per-call batch cap (up to 100 requests per batch call, with webhooks). Its enterprise page describes queue behavior: dedicated GPUs with guaranteed throughput, so renders 'never queue behind anyone'. Beyond that, the evidence does not document concurrency limits, rate limits, or how queuing works on standard plans. Missing for 10: documented concurrent-render limits per plan, rate limits, standard-tier queue/priority semantics and expected wait times, retry/backoff guidance, and independent corroboration.
